concept.title: Trigger events
concept.shortdesc: Triggered automations listen to the workspace's events. Available events:

conbody.p: The org. events belong to the workspace, not to a project, so they fire only automations that cover the whole workspace (see What an automation covers*); an automation that covers one project never sees them.
Filters narrow the match with key/value pairs on the event payload (for example only artifacts of a certain type). Two safety valves keep triggered automations from running away:
